title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Application of Law to the Act of Illegally Operating International or Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Telecommunications Services

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
February 6, 2002
Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issues concerning the Application of Law to Acts of Illegally Operating International or Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Regional Telecommunications Business
(Adopted at the 102nd Meeting of the Ninth Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on January 8, 2002)
Gao Jian Fa Shi Zi [2002] No. 1
Fujian Provincial People's Procuratorate:
Your Request for Instructions on How to Apply the Provisions of Article 225, Item (4) of the Criminal Law (Min Jian [2000] No. 65) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
Any person who, in violation of the provisions of the Telecommunications Regulations of the People's Republic of China, by leasing international dedicated telecommunication lines, privately installing switching equipment, or by other means, operates international or Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Macao Special Administrative Region and Taiwan Region telecommunications business without authorization for profit-making activities, disrupts the order of the telecommunication market management, and the circumstances are serious, shall, in accordance with the provisions of Article 225, Item (4) of the Criminal Law, be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of illegal business operation.
This reply.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
February 6, 2002
